# Vendored MCP documentation indexes

These files are local snapshots of the official LLM-oriented documentation indexes,
with the primary implementation, security, extension, and specification links
needed for this showcase:

- `llms.txt` — MCP documentation and specification index
- `python-sdk-llms.txt` — official Python SDK documentation index

Sources:

- https://modelcontextprotocol.io/llms.txt
- https://py.sdk.modelcontextprotocol.io/llms.txt

Retrieved: 2026-07-25

The indexes are vendored for local agent/documentation discovery. The linked
specification pages remain the authoritative source and should be refreshed
when MCP publishes a new specification revision.
